record.one_liner: Close is a sales CRM for SMB teams that combines leads, contacts, calling, email/SMS, sequences and pipeline reporting.
record.auth_notes: API keys are sent via HTTP Basic Auth and are created in Settings > Developer > API Keys (tied to a user and organization). OAuth 2.0 is documented for user-facing integrations. You create an OAuth app in Settings > Developer > OAuth Apps and receive a Client ID and Secret. Apps get all.full_access and offline_access scopes by default; other scopes need support contact. The hosted MCP server also accepts a Close-API-Key header.
record.access_notes: Close offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card. I found no free tier. Pricing page lists Solo $9/mo annual ($19 monthly), Essentials $35, Growth $99 and Scale $139 per user per month on annual billing. High-volume API access is listed as included on Essentials and above and not on Solo. What basic API access Solo gets is not stated on the pages I fetched. Which plan the trial covers is unstated. Whether API keys need a particular plan is not stated in the docs I fetched. OAuth app creation is self-serve and private by default. Publishing an app for other Close customers goes through a publishing review. I did not fetch that page, so the process is unverified.
record.blocker: No permanent free tier: the trial lasts 14 days, then a paid plan is needed. Solo's API limits are unclear. Rate limits vary by endpoint, and the docs give no numbers. Publishing a public OAuth app involves a review that I did not verify. Non-default OAuth scopes require contacting support.
